scenarios.title: Verify evaluation results load from default filename
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the evaluation results API loads data from the pre-change filename 'results.json' and returns available:true with a valid benchmark date.

scenarios.title: Verify UI shows 'BugsJS review baseline' when evaluation results are present
scenarios.purpose: Confirm the UI displays the heading 'BugsJS review baseline' with cohort count, review model, and benchmark date matching the pre-change evaluation results data.

scenarios.title: Verify footer pipeline status displays 'not configured'
scenarios.purpose: Check the footer text shows 'Pipeline status: not configured' indicating the API is not ready due to missing config keys, according to the pre-change environment.

scenarios.title: Verify buttons are disabled due to setup required status
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that 'Index repository context', 'Analyze change' and 'Generate Playwright plan' buttons remain disabled when API key and database URL are not configured.

scenarios.title: Verify inline setup hint is visible
scenarios.purpose: Confirm that the inline setup hint 'Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.' is visible on the main page before configuration is done.

steps.expected: Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.
